annotations.title: Most-favorited Etsy listings for a search

description: Runs one Etsy search (first 100 active listings, relevance order) and ranks those listings by Etsy's own favorite count (num_favorers: the number of users who marked the listing a favorite), with title, link, price in the shop's currency and the year listed. Favorites are not sales: Etsy does not publish sales per listing, so this is not a best-seller list. Use for 'what do shoppers favorite on Etsy for <product>?' and product-idea research.
